C-R2-UPLOAD-FEEDBACK-320.Summary: Make document upload feedback truthful and file-specific without changing storage or processing semantics.
C-R2-UPLOAD-FEEDBACK-320.Problem: Generic batch upload always ends with «Документы приняты» even when individual requests failed, while protocol import uses the same saved-source explanation for both in-flight upload and already-saved processing.

Goals.Goal: Distinguish client upload from server-confirmed saved/processing state.
Summarize batch results from confirmed HTTP outcomes so one failed file does not turn the whole batch into success or block good files.
Keep successful documents available immediately while exposing retry/error only for the failed item.

Constraints.Constraint: No SQLite schema, OCR contract, immutable source, ACL, installer or version change.
No modal or extra confirmation is added.
One failed request must not stop later files in the same batch.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Add a new workflow or release gate.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: While bytes are still being sent, UI says the file is uploading and does not claim the source is saved.
After a successful server response but before processing finishes, UI says the source is saved and processing continues.
One successful and one rejected file produce a visible summary equivalent to «1 сохранён, 1 ошибка».
Successful files remain usable and failed files retain their error without blocking the batch.
Ready and needs-review states keep their existing meaning.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head CI proves the batch summary helper and existing protocol import regressions; browser spec contains the mixed success/error UI path without adding a dedicated workflow.
